name: Are awning windows energy-efficient?
description: Awning windows are energy-efficient due to their tight seal when closed. Look for features like multi-pane glass, Low-E coatings, and argon gas for best perform

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes, awning windows are generally considered energy-efficient. Their crank-out design creates a strong seal when closed, which helps to prevent air leakage better than some other window styles. To maximize energy efficiency, look for windows with features like double or triple-pane glass, low-emissivity (Low-E) coatings, and argon gas fills. These features help reduce heat transfer, keeping your home more comfortable and potentially lowering energy costs.
